title: Open U And Integral Toe Heel Calk Pitching Horseshoe
description: One independently authored complete pitching-horseshoe-inspired static prop: one thick open U material body with two extended gently flared heel arms, a continuous rounded toe, integral raised heel shoulders and a broad raised toe calk. The central void is truly open out through the wide front gap; finite bevels, continuous inner and outer walls and a full flat underside are actual geometry. One connected closed genus-zero whole mesh with three constant opaque PBR face roles, metre-style native Z up and centred ground. No nail holes, letters, fasteners, pole, throwing scene, motion or detached calk pieces. Not a horseshoe-shaped router sole extracted from its tool, and not a bent boomerang wing recoloured or shortened: no prior geometry is imported. Broad sports-equipment category only with invented proportions and plain surfaces, not a branded or competition replica. One original model zero scenes. Static unoccupied visual prop only; no actual throwing, official size or mass, scoring, balance, grip, impact, material strength, manufacturing or safety capability. No textures, animation, rigging or interaction.
